info.title: Market Lane order-service API
info.description: Market Lane e-commerce microservice. All money values are USD.

get.summary: Returns the signed-in user's cart with server-calculated totals.

delete.summary: Removes every item from the cart.

post.summary: Adds a product to the cart or increases its quantity.

put.summary: Changes the quantity of a cart item.

delete.summary: Removes an item from the cart.

post.summary: Validates the cart, reserves stock, takes payment and creates an order.

get.summary: Returns the signed-in user's order history.
Returns all orders with optional status filtering. Admin only.
Returns one order with its items, address and payment.

patch.summary: Changes an order status. Admin only.

get.summary: Returns the payment for an order owned by the current user (or any order for admins).
Returns homepage recommendations, personalized when signed in.
Returns products related to the one being viewed.

Bearer.description: JWT access token returned by the User Service login endpoint.

tags.name: Chat
tags.description:
Store support assistant. Available to anonymous visitors for product and FAQ
questions; order-specific details are only read for the signed-in customer.

tags.name: Recommendations
tags.description:
Personalized recommendations. Anonymous callers receive popular products;
signed-in callers get suggestions based on their own order history.
